preconditions.description: The number of integers n is between 1 and 24 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= 10**9 for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Each integer ai in the list a is a positive integer not exceeding 10^9.
The sum of all integers in a equals d, where d is the distance between Iahub and Iahubina.
The number of bad luck integers k is between 0 and 2 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 10**9 for x in bad_luck) if k > 0 else True
preconditions.description: Each bad luck integer x is a positive integer not exceeding 10^9.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the number of good routes modulo 10^9 + 7.

postconditions.expression: all(not any(bad_luck == sum(b[:j+1]) for j in range(n)) for b in permutations(a)) if k == 0 else True
postconditions.description: For each permutation b of a, the route is good if none of the partial sums of b (i.e., b[0], b[0]+b[1], ..., sum(b)) are in the bad_luck set.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == sum(1 for b in permutations(a) if all(sum(b[:j+1]) not in bad_luck for j in range(n))) % 1000000007
postconditions.description: The output is the count of permutations of a where none of the partial sums are in the bad_luck set, modulo 10^9 + 7.
